name: Aspen Snowmass
why: A ski town with one famous pair of peaks. At 9.6 it sits above Glacier & Waterton Lakes, Acadia and Rocky Mountain National Park, which all feel stronger.

name: Red Sea & Nile
why: Giza and the Nile are monuments and a river strip. At 9.6 it sits above Death Valley, Arches and Sedona, which are more purely landscape.

name: Athens
why: A city under an Acropolis. At 9.3 it is level with Greenland, the Faroe Islands and Olympic National Park; every other city below Rio and Cape Town is at 8.5 or lower.

name: Algarve
why: Golden cliffs and coves are lovely but feel smaller than the Dalmatian Coast and Santorini, which it sits above.

name: Acadia National Park
why: A beautiful small park. At 9.4 it sits above Olympic and North Cascades, which are larger and wilder.

name: Sedona
why: Striking red rock but smaller in scale than Zion, Arches and Death Valley, which it should sit under.

name: Bavaria & Munich
why: Alpine foothills and lakes. At 9.2 it ties with the Ecuadorian Andes and the Caucasus, which are far bigger mountains.

name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
why: Gentle forested ridges. At 9.2 it sits above Rocky Mountain National Park and Denali.

name: Vermont
why: Most of its score is autumn color. At 9.2 it sits above Denali and the Scottish Highlands.

name: Black Forest
why: Wooded hills and valleys. At 9.0 it ties with Chiapas, Ireland and Cornwall.

name: Cape Cod & the Islands
why: Dunes and gray-shingled villages. At 9.0 it ties with Cornwall and Ireland.

name: Marlborough & Abel Tasman
why: Pleasant bays and sounds, but at 9.1 it is level with Bhutan and Tuscany, which feel grander.

name: Nova Scotia
why: The Cabot Trail and granite shores are good rather than great; 9.1 is level with Bhutan and Tuscany.

name: Amsterdam
why: A flat canal city. At 8.0 it sits above Budapest, Istanbul and Hong Kong, and 1.6 above Venice.

name: Budapest
why: A fine river city, but 7.9 puts it above Istanbul and Hong Kong, whose settings are bigger.

name: Palm Springs & Joshua Tree
why: Owner picked 8.6 (suggested 8.4). Pleasant desert, but 8.9 sits above Mongolia and the Badlands, which feel larger.

name: Pantanal
why: Flat wetland; 8.9 puts it level with the Galápagos and Costa Rica.

name: Hudson Valley
why: Rolling hills and a river; 8.5 puts it level with Tasmania and Nice.

name: Queenstown
why: Lake and mountains, but 9.6 puts it above Glacier & Waterton Lakes and Monterey & Big Sur.

name: Sydney
why: A harbor city; 8.5 puts it above Quebec City & Montreal and Wales without the setting to match.

name: Great Barrier Reef
why: Mostly seen underwater or from the air; 9.7 puts it level with Petra and Guilin.

name: Antarctic Peninsula
why: Glaciers calving into the sea, icebergs and mountains; 9.1 sits level with Tuscany and Nova Scotia.

name: Greenland
why: Icefjords and icebergs on a huge scale; 9.3 is level with the Faroe Islands and Athens.

name: Svalbard
why: Glaciers and arctic coast; 9.1 is level with Fiji and Sicily.

name: Northern Tanzania
why: Owner picked 9.1 (declined 9.4). Serengeti, Ngorongoro and Kilimanjaro together; 9.0 is level with Cape Cod.

name: Rocky Mountain National Park
why: Real high mountains; 9.0 puts it below Vermont and the Great Smoky Mountains.

name: Denali & the Interior
why: The Alaska Range is a major mountain landscape; 9.0 is below the Great Smoky Mountains.

name: Scottish Highlands & Isle of Skye
why: Skye, Glencoe and the lochs; 8.9 is below Vermont and the Great Smoky Mountains.

name: Cusco & Sacred Valley
why: Machu Picchu in its mountain setting; 9.7 is level with Guilin and Petra.

name: Bhutan
why: Himalayan valleys and the Tiger's Nest; 9.1 is below Bavaria.

name: Chilean Lake District
why: Volcanoes over lakes; 8.7 sits well below the Argentine Lake District at 9.3 for similar scenery.

name: Maasai Mara & Amboseli
why: Kilimanjaro over open savanna; 8.3 is level with Maui and the Canary Islands.

name: Big Island
why: Active volcanoes, lava coasts and waterfalls; 8.1 is level with Puglia.

name: Maui
why: Haleakalā crater and the Hana coast; 8.3 is level with the Upper Peninsula.

name: Taiwan
why: Taroko Gorge and Alishan; 7.9 is below Chiang Mai and Amsterdam.

name: Vietnam
why: Ha Long Bay and Sapa terraces; 8.5 is level with Sydney and Nice.

name: Palau
why: The Rock Islands are among the world's best seascapes; 8.4 is level with Okinawa and Piedmont.

name: Kyrgyzstan
why: Tian Shan lakes and peaks; 8.9 is level with Bali and Costa Rica.

name: Venice
why: Unique, and the best urban view anywhere; 6.4 is below Aruba and Tokyo & Kyoto.

name: Prague
why: Castle and river skyline; 6.3 is level with the Cotswolds and Bordeaux and below Hong Kong.

name: Edinburgh
why: A castle on a crag with Arthur's Seat behind; 6.2 is below Rioja and St Andrews & Fife.

name: Lisbon
why: Hills over the Tagus; 6.0 is level with Mexico City and London.

name: Bend & Crater Lake
why: Crater Lake is a standout; 8.4 is level with Piedmont and Okinawa.

name: Hokkaido
why: Volcanoes, lakes and lavender; 7.8 is level with Napa & Sonoma.
